# nemau network security-group enable-egress-filtering

Converts a security group created before egress filtering existed.

The group receives two egress rules that allow all outbound traffic (0.0.0.0/0 and ::/0), then the instances carrying it have their outbound policy recomputed: an instance whose groups all filter egress only sends what one of their egress rules allows. Traffic is unchanged when the task completes; removing or narrowing the new rules afterwards takes effect.

The conversion cannot be undone. Running it again on a converted group does nothing.

## Usage

```
nemau network security-group enable-egress-filtering <id>
```

## Global options

```
      --api-url string           API origin (default: $NEMAU_API_URL, then https://api.nemau-cloud.com)
      --idempotency-key string   key making a write safe to repeat: 1-128 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : - (default: generated)
  -o, --output string            output format: table, json (default "table")
      --project string           target project, by id or by name (default: $NEMAU_PROJECT_ID, then the saved project)
  -q, --quiet                    print ids only
      --timeout duration         how long to wait for one operation (default 30m0s)
      --wait                     wait for asynchronous operations to finish (default true)
```
